records.issue_text: packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:254 — Updating a legacy event without externalCalendarId now searches for a calendar whose ID equals undefined, so Google receives no calendarId instead of the destination calendar.
records.rationale: In updateEvent/deleteEvent of GoogleCalendarService, the old fallback `: event.destinationCalendar?.externalId` was replaced with `event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. In the fallback branch, externalCalendarId is undefined/falsy, so the find compares against undefined and always fails, yielding undefined calendarId — the destination calendar is never used when externalCalendarId is absent, a behavior regression introduced by this diff.
